outcome: adverse outcome in the third stage
cohort: 589 healthy women with a singleton term cephalic pregnancy
finding: Midwife-led care in alongside midwifery units (AMU) was superior to obstetrician-led care for mode of birth and other outcomes in low-risk women.
mod_finding: The study found that midwife-led units had a higher rate of vaginal birth compared to obstetrician-led units.
